questions.question: As of August 6th, 2025, the RBI in its Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting decided to maintain the repo rate at ___________.
Who was the union finance minister at the time of adoption of the new economic policy of 1991 in India?
Which Marathi writer and critic was selected for the Chintha Raveendran Award for 2025?
According to Article 19(2) of the Indian Constitution, on what grounds can the government impose reasonable restrictions on the freedom of speech and expression?
options: For the convenience of government officials
To protect the privacy of public officials
In the interest of national security and public order
In the interest of individual opinions and personal beliefs
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (In the interest of national security and public order) है।

questions.question: Which Indian city hosted the first-ever ASEAN–India Cruise Dialogue in 2025?

In July 2025, the National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS), under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, signed a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with which of the following organizations?
Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Light needs a medium to travel.
Light has the same speed in every medium.
Light is an electromagnetic wave and therefore, it does not require a medium to travel.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Light is an electromagnetic wave and therefore, it does not require a medium to travel.) है।

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT considered as the classical language of India?
According to the United Nations Development Programme's (UNDP) report, what percentage of countries experienced a reduction in their Human Development Index (HDI) value in 2020 or 2021?
According to Article 371-C, the President is authorised to provide for the creation of a committee of the Manipur Legislative Assembly consisting of members elected from the _______________.

After the Revolt of 1857, the British introduced the Indian Arms Act in which year, according to which no Indian was allowed to manufacture, sell or even carry a weapon without a license from the government?
During the reign of which of the following Mughal emperors did the British establish their factory in Surat in 1612-1613?
Which of the following solvents has the lowest polarity?
Which of the following statements is correct regarding the location of the Great Indian Desert in relation to the Aravali Hills?
options: The Great Indian Desert lies to the northwest of the Aravali Hills
The Great Indian Desert lies to the northeast of the Aravali Hills
The Great Indian Desert lies to the north of the Aravali Hills
The Great Indian Desert lies to the east of the Aravali Hills
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The Great Indian Desert lies to the northwest of the Aravali Hills) है।

questions.question: Arrange the following events related to Gandhiji in chronological order.1. Gandhiji was involved in a labour dispute in Gujarat also known as Ahmedabad Mill Strike.2. Gandhiji was advised by Gokhale to travel around India to know its land and people.3. Gandhiji delivered his first major speech in India at Banaras Hindu University.4. Gandhiji was approached by a peasant from Champaran regarding the exploitation of peasants by indigo planters, during the Lucknow Session of Congress.
What is a tariff?
options: A tax on imports or exports
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (A tax on imports or exports) है।

questions.question: The bulk modulus of a material is defined as  _______.
options: Hydraulic stress to the corresponding hydraulic strain
Change in length under applied stress
Change in elasticity due to load
Ratio of normal stress to change in length
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Hydraulic stress to the corresponding hydraulic strain) है।

questions.question: In which city was the National Convention on Model Women-Friendly Gram Panchayats organized on 5th March 2025?
In July 2025, Hockey India conducted its 15th Hockey India Congress in which place?
Which conservation initiative, launched by the Government of India in 1974, helped save Indian crocodiles from extinction?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The Indian Crocodile Conservation Project) है।
